card.name: Population and statistics phrasing
card.fires_on: Words inside statistical or population statements, such as a group noun, a number digit, or a verb after "each" or "every". Seen in fact lists and statistics about countries, people or patients.

modes.label: Group or population words
modes.description: Nouns or verbs naming a population in a statistic, like metro areas or each American.
modes.example: Almost three-quarters of the 300 metro<< areas>> had higher levels of employment

modes.label: Digits inside large numbers
modes.description: A digit within a patient count or large figure.

modes.label: Rate phrases
modes.description: Small words in "every minute", "98% of", or "live in" statements.
modes.example: 98%<< of>> American households purchase ice cream.

card.plain: It lights up in sentences giving statistics about how many people or groups do something.
